definitions.explanation: The movement or operation of a vehicle along a road or track. Used almost exclusively for vehicles, not for people running on foot.

examples.japanese: {走行|そうこう}{距離|きょり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦{高速|こうそく}{道路|どうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{時速|じそく}→時速：00128_jisoku⟧100⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{走行|そうこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To drive at 100 km/h on the expressway.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{走行|そうこう}{距離|きょり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧10{万|まん}⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えている→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦まだまだ→まだまだ：10505_madamada⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: This car has over 100,000 kilometers on it, but it still runs well.

notes:
{走行|そうこう} refers specifically to the movement of vehicles, not people. It is commonly seen on car dashboards, in driving manuals, and in traffic-related contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {走行|そうこう}{距離|きょり} (mileage, distance traveled)
- {走行|そうこう}{中|ちゅう} (while driving/in motion)
- {走行|そうこう}⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧ (driving speed)
- {走行|そうこう}{車線|しゃせん} (driving lane)
- ⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧{走行|そうこう} (autonomous driving)

WHEN NOT USED:
{走行|そうこう} is not used for people running on foot. Use ⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ or ⟦ランニング→ランニング：08018_ranningu⟧ for that.
